counting_contract.primary: One editorial primary per scored part. Its whole marks belong once to that primary, not a Cambridge marking-point allocation.
counting_contract.assessed: All operations newly assessed within a part. Incidence and whole-part marks overlap between patterns; never sum pattern rows.
counting_contract.context_only: Invoked, previously provided or tested operations. These are NOT newly implemented/assessed incidence.
counting_contract.union: To total a selection of assessed patterns, take the distinct union of part_id first, then sum each original mark once.
counting_contract.denominators: 29 published paper identities is primary; 21 normalized-text and 23 render-corroborated representative groups are sensitivity views, not independent exam observations.
counting_contract.limited_evidence: Flag when assessed in at most two normalized-text groups. This editorial threshold measures corpus support, not syllabus importance or future probability.
counting_contract.prediction: No future-exam probability, completeness of 2026 syllabus, or frequency beyond this frozen corpus is claimed.
